content.text: Selling digital products is a lucrative business, but traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-step-step-deployment|payment]] gateways like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad often come with restrictive policies and hefty fees. In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, these gateways are unavailable or severely restricted, leaving digital sellers with limited options. The problem is real, and it's not just about geographical restrictions – it's about the infrastructure itself. Many digital sellers are forced to rely on platforms that take a significant cut of their revenue, sometimes up to 10% on every sale. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to payments]], on the other hand, charges a mere 0.5% fee, making it an attractive alternative for those looking to break free from platform fees. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-online-without-gumroad-8|The Real]] retains $921, a staggering figure that highlights the importance of choosing the right infrastructure. In this post, we'll delve into the world of no-KYC payment gateways and explore how digital sellers can sell their products online without relying on traditional payment gateways like Stripe.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway is a type of infrastructure that enables digital sellers to process payments without requiring Know-Your-Customer (KYC) verification. This is particularly important for digital sellers who operate in countries with restrictive policies or those who prefer to keep their personal and financial information private. NOWPayments, a leading no-KYC payment gateway, offers a range of cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for those looking to break free from traditional payment gateways. By using a no-KYC payment gateway, digital sellers can maintain control over their infrastructure and revenue, ensuring that they receive the maximum amount possible for their products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments is built on top of a decentralized infrastructure, which enables instant and secure transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, and the corresponding amount is credited to the seller's wallet. The entire process is automated, ensuring that the seller receives their revenue without any intermediaries or fees. Additionally, NOWPayments offers a range of tools and integrations, making it easy for digital sellers to set up and manage their payments. By leveraging this infrastructure, digital sellers can focus on what matters most – creating and selling their products.

NOWPayments is built for digital sellers who operate in countries with restrictive policies or those who prefer to keep their personal and financial information private. It's also an attractive option for those who want to avoid traditional payment gateways like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. By using a no-KYC payment gateway, digital sellers can break free from platform fees and build a more scalable and sustainable business model.

Additionally, the range of tools and integrations makes it easy for digital sellers to set up and manage their payments. By leveraging these components, digital sellers can create a seamless and efficient payment experience for their customers.
